nodes.title: Mass roll-up against allocations and the gate
nodes.equation: basic = sum m_i ; predicted = sum m_i (1 + MGA_i) ; margin = gate - predicted ; overrun_s = basic_s - alloc_s

nodes.title: CG cases, pack station for the target, hover trim split
nodes.equation: cg = sum m_i r_i / sum m_i ; x_pack_req = (x_t M - (M x_cg - m_p x_p)) / m_p ; split = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg) ; h_stance = c - x_cg + foot ; fwd_room = (x_pack - L_pack/2) - x_pod_le ; range_use = |x - mid| / half-range ; shift_req(group) = (x_t - x_cg) M / m_group

nodes.title: Inertia tensor about the CG (aircraft frame)
nodes.equation: I = sum m_i (|r_i|^2 E - r_i r_i^T) + box self-inertia m/12 (b^2 + c^2) ; r_i from the CG

nodes.title: Weigh every bought part and the first core and fin

nodes.title: Bifilar pendulum inertia

nodes.title: Interface plan graph checks
nodes.equation: connected = |main structural cluster| / |flight parts| ; powered = electrical parts reached from a source / all ; field = count(edges with field_disconnect) ; id_violations = count(id-rule breaches)

nodes.title: Planned parts all connected
nodes.how: python -I redesign/team/A4/interface_plan.py; then merge_check.py on the real subsystems reports no 'floating'

nodes.title: Planned electrical parts all powered
nodes.how: interface_plan.py; merge_check.py reports no 'unpowered'/'unconnected'; bench power-up per H1

nodes.title: One field disconnect (pack plug)
nodes.how: count field-disconnect joints in the merged graph; field set-up timed by H2 (one plug, four prop nuts)

nodes.title: Planned part ids follow the instance-id rule
nodes.how: interface_plan.py id_rule(): <PREFIX>-NNN[-UR|UL|LR|LL|L|R], NNN 001-899, no retired id; --compare lists any declared id outside the plan; A3 mass_rollup.py maps instances to parts.csv lines by it

nodes.title: Planned interfaces
nodes.how: interface_plan.py --compare: every planned edge declared and acknowledged

nodes.title: Wing section coordinates (S5010)
nodes.text: Normalised Selig-order coordinates of the S5010 read from subsystems/wing/s5010.dat, the file CAD lofts
nodes.basis: B2's copy of the UIUC coordinate file (URL and checked date in its header line); D1 owns the subsystems/wing copy; params wing.airfoil = S5010 (CHANGE-LOG D-02)

nodes.title: Minimum foam over the spar
nodes.text: Hot-wired XPS must keep at least 2 mm of foam between the spar tube and the skin on both surfaces
nodes.basis: A5 modelling standard: thinner foam tears when the slot is cut and the tube bonded; G2 confirms on a test core

nodes.title: Minimum elevon end gap
nodes.text: Each elevon panel end stays at least 10 mm from the pod side, the fin face and the wing tip
nodes.basis: A5 modelling standard: room for tape, a horn and +/-25 deg travel without rubbing; D6 confirms

nodes.title: Allocation split and lump stations used for the layout CG (R1 skeleton)
nodes.text: Within each allocation: wing = spar (mass/m x length); the rest split between core and elevon panels with the tape skin by planform area and foam/fill/consumables by section volume; fins = 4 half-fins (rest) + 2 x 43 tube + 4 x 18 mount + 2 x 20 through-core block + 2 x 30 clip set; propulsion = 4 x prop (params) at the prop plane + rest (motor, ESC, adapter, nut) as the motor envelope; power = pack centred in the pod + rest at the pod nose; pod and avionics in the pod; mechanisms 23.5 mm ahead of the hinge; harness as two bundle legs (channel 14 mm aft of the spar surface, tube inboard face); printed walls 3 mm; growth reserve not placed
nodes.basis: params.json#mass.allocation_g notes (CHANGE-LOG D-07); the skeleton modules (redesign/fusion/skeleton/*/fusion) use the same numbers
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Elevon hinge line
nodes.equation: x_h = c (1 - f) ; z_h = upper surface at x_h/c ; t_h = section thickness at the hinge

nodes.title: Foam cover over the spar
nodes.equation: cover_up = z_upper(x_s) - (z_s + r) ; cover_lo = (z_s - r) - z_lower(x_s) ; z_camber = (z_upper + z_lower)/2 ; cover_on_camber = (t(x_s) - 2r)/2

nodes.title: Elevon end gaps
nodes.equation: pod = y_in0 - w_pod/2 ; fin_in = (y_fin - t_fin/2) - y_in1 ; fin_out = y_out0 - (y_fin + t_fin/2) ; tip = b/2 - y_out1 ; t_fin = layers t_board

nodes.title: Layout CG: allocations at the R1 datum stations
nodes.equation: x_cg = sum(m_i x_i) / sum(m_i), z likewise (lump centroids from the k09kit geometry); pack x for x_target = x_pack + M (x_target - x_cg) / m_pack ; hover split upper/lower = (z_m + z_cg) / (z_m - z_cg)

nodes.title: CG balance of the built aircraft
nodes.procedure: Pack in, props on; two knife edges under the wing at the fin roots; mark x (H1).

nodes.title: APC PER3 performance file, 11x4.5MR
nodes.where: block 'PROP RPM = 6000', columns J, Ct, Cp (all 30 rows to zero thrust at J 0.545)
nodes.note: APC's own blade-element prediction, not a wind-tunnel test; static values run ~10 % optimistic (K09 REVIEW section 3, J1 REFERENCES). B4 owns the prop data.

nodes.title: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag (1965)
nodes.where: ch. 3: flat plate normal to flow CD 1.17-1.28 by aspect ratio; ch. 2-6 component drag
nodes.note: CD90 1.28 is the value the K09 card and REVIEW used for the hover-lean check; kept for continuity
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: Helmbold lift slope for low aspect ratio
nodes.where: Raymer, Aircraft Design: A Conceptual Approach, 6th ed., eq. 12.6 (swept form reduces to Helmbold at zero sweep)
nodes.note: a = 2 pi AR / (2 + sqrt(AR^2 + 4)) with a 2-D slope of 2 pi
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: ArduPilot Plane tailsitter and airspeed parameters
nodes.where: Q_TAILSIT_ANGLE, Q_TAILSIT_RAT_FW, Q_ASSIST_SPEED, AIRSPEED_MIN/CRUISE
nodes.note: parameter names only; values below are B1 proposals for F4
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: APC PER3 11x5.5MR rows as copied by B4
nodes.where: team/B4/data/apc_per3_11x55MR.csv, rows rpm = 6000 (19 rows, J 0 to 0.624)
nodes.note: B1 compared every 6 000 rpm row of B4's file with PROP_TABLE on 2026-11-09. APC's blade-element prediction, not a test; B4 owns the prop data

nodes.title: 11x5.5MR Ct and Cp versus J
nodes.text: The fitted prop (APC 11x5.5MR, params propulsion.prop) follows APC's PER3 Ct(J), Cp(J) at 6 000 rpm at every operating point; rows are [J, Ct, Cp]; last row extrapolated to zero thrust
nodes.basis: B4's copy of the APC file; cruise runs at 6 000 rpm (CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM); Re effect between the 5 000 and 7 000 rpm blocks < 1 % on Ct, Cp; the hover-table calibration (CALC-B1-PROPCAL) absorbs APC's static optimism

nodes.title: 11x4.5MR Ct and Cp versus J (calibration reference)
nodes.text: APC PER3 11x4.5MR at 6 000 rpm, rows [J, Ct, Cp]; used only to calibrate the chain to the maker table (11x4.7) and for the 11x5.5MR / 11x4.5MR hover power ratio
nodes.basis: APC data file read 2026-11-09 (rev 1 of this script); the 11x4.5MR is closer in pitch to the maker's 11x4.7 than the 11x5.5MR, so it carries the calibration with less prop error

nodes.title: Zero-lift drag build-up coefficients, non-wing parts
nodes.text: [Cf fin/pod, FF fin, CD motor tube (frontal, faired by the fin), CdA per motor m2, FF pod, interference factor] = [0.0070, 1.20, 0.30, 0.0004, 1.30, 1.15]
nodes.basis: Same coefficients as the K09 card and the K01 card, accepted by the K09 REVIEW (section 4: 'already pessimistic'); turbulent flat plate at Re 3e5 for the paper-faced board and pod; Hoerner for the tube. The wing now uses B2's S5010 section drag (ASM-B1-WING-ROUGH)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Tape-seam factor on the S5010 wing profile drag
nodes.text: The packing-tape wing has 1.10 x the XFOIL Ncrit 9 profile drag that B2's AVL polar carries
nodes.basis: B2 CR-B2-08: S5010 cd at cl 0.47 is 0.0087 (Re 3e5, Ncrit 9) and 0.0096 (Re 2.3e5, Ncrit 5); the ratio 1.10 stands in for early transition at spanwise tape seams. A trip-strip XFOIL run (B2) or the cruise-power test replaces it

nodes.title: Flat-plate normal-force coefficient
nodes.text: Wing normal-force coefficient beyond stall CN = CD90 sin(alpha), CD90 = 1.28
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat plate; the value the K09 card used for hover lean, kept so the numbers compare. Low-AR wings with end plates keep more post-stall lift, so this under-predicts lift in transition (conservative)

nodes.title: ESC efficiency
nodes.text: ESC efficiency 0.95 in hover and cruise
nodes.basis: K09 card value; BLHeli_S at 7-30 A
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Avionics and servo power
nodes.text: FC, GPS, receiver, telemetry, airspeed sensor and two elevon servos draw 6 W together
nodes.basis: card 5 W + 1 W for the two servos

nodes.title: Cruise trim drag factor
nodes.text: Trim adds 2 % to cruise drag on top of B2's trimmed wing polar
nodes.basis: B2's polar (P:b2.avl.e_oswald, cd0_wing) is already trimmed, elevon profile drag included; B3 finds +0.2 % induced trim drag at 16 m/s (CR-B3-07). The 2 % left covers the up-trimmed elevon gap and pod/fin junctions. Was 1.05 (K09 card) before B2/B3 answered

nodes.title: Proposed cruise airspeed 16 m/s
nodes.text: B1 proposes AIRSPEED_CRUISE = 16 m/s (params.json#performance.cruise_ms, CHANGE-LOG D-01)
nodes.basis: lowest whole-number speed above 1.3 Vs at the 2.6 kg gate with B2's trimmed CLmax 0.80 on the c 0.32 wing (15.43 m/s, CL-B1-VT-GATE); +3.7 %, about 0.6 m/s for airspeed-hold and sensor error (R-AIRSPEED-ERR allows 1 m/s, so the margin is thin)

nodes.title: Pessimistic-case factors
nodes.text: [CD0 factor, prop efficiency factor, hover power factor] = [1.30, 0.85, 1.10]; the pessimistic case also uses params wing.oswald_e (0.80) in place of B2's 0.93
nodes.basis: CD0 x 1.3 as the K09 REVIEW pessimistic case; prop efficiency 15 % below APC (BEMT optimism, tractor prop ahead of a fin and tube); hover +10 % for APC static optimism and the 11x4.7 maker table (400 W x 1.10 = 440 W, E2's pessimistic 29.9 A x 14.8 V = 443 W)

nodes.title: Thrust kept for attitude control
nodes.text: Steady flight may use at most 80 % of available thrust (sagged pack); 20 % stays for control
nodes.basis: common multirotor practice (hover throttle <= 50-60 %, never saturate in steady state); a tailsitter controls pitch in hover and transition by differential thrust only

nodes.title: Landing attitude error
nodes.text: Attitude error at touchdown, on top of the steady wind lean, is 10 deg
nodes.basis: first-order allowance for gusts and controller error in QLAND; C5 and H2 refine from the twin's logs

nodes.title: Pitch-over schedule
nodes.text: [pitch rate deg/s, assist speed as a fraction of Vs, back-transition energy as a fraction of the forward pitch-over] = [12, 1.10, 1.0]
nodes.basis: 12 deg/s is the fastest whole-number pitch-down rate that keeps peak thrust <= 80 % of available in CALC-B1-PITCHOVER on the worst-case pack (sag 0.72, D-06): 13 deg/s gives 0.79, 15 gives 0.84, 20 gives 0.96 (rev 1 used 20 at sag 0.93). On a fresh pack 20 deg/s gives 0.59 (performance_results.json#sensitivity). Proposed first-flight Q_TAILSIT_RAT_FW; thrust holds altitude below 1.1 Vs (Q_ASSIST_SPEED analogue); the back-transition is a pitch-up deceleration of similar length at similar thrust

nodes.title: Aero model: CD0, k, lift slope, stall angle
nodes.equation: CD0 = IF [CD0_wing,B2 f_rough + Cf FF Swet_fins + Cd_tube d L + n CdA_motor + Cf FF Swet_pod] / S, Swet_fin = 2 A (1 + 0.2 t/c) ; k = 1/(pi AR e_B2) ; k_pess = 1/(pi AR e_params) ; a = CLa (B2 AVL) ; alpha_s = alpha0 + CLmax/a ; L/D max = 1/(2 sqrt(CD0 k))
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Stall and transition speeds
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2 m g/(rho S CLmax)) ; Vt = 1.3 Vs ; Vs30 = Vs/sqrt(cos 30) ; margin = Vcruise/Vt - 1
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Prop and motor chain, calibrated to the maker table
nodes.equation: n_max = sqrt(T0/(Ct0 rho D^4)) (11x5.5MR) ; n_max,sag = n_max sqrt(sag) ; k_cal = P_table(690 gf) / P_motor(11x4.5MR model at 690 gf, J = 0) ; FM = T^1.5/(sqrt(2 rho A) P_shaft) (11x5.5MR)

nodes.title: Hover power, current, endurance and thrust headroom
nodes.equation: T_motor = m DL / n ; r = P_motor(11x5.5MR, T) / P_motor(11x4.5MR, T) ; P = n P_table(T_motor) r / eta_esc + P_av ; I = P / V ; t_hover = E (1 - reserve) / P ; throttle = m g DL / (n T_max sag)

nodes.title: Cruise at the proposed speed, gate mass
nodes.equation: CL = 2W/(rho V^2 S) ; D = q S (CD0 + k CL^2) trim ; prop: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = D/n ; P_el = n k_cal P_motor(Cp rho n^3 D^5) / eta_esc + P_av ; eta_drive = P_shaft / (P_el - P_av) ; pess: CD0 x 1.3, k_pess (e 0.80), eta_prop x 0.85

nodes.title: Cruise power and cruise time versus airspeed
nodes.equation: for V in 14..20 m/s: P_el(V) as CALC-B1-CRUISE ; t = (E(1-res) - P_h t_h - 2 E_tr)/P_el ; pess: P_h and E_tr x 1.10 and the pessimistic P_el

nodes.title: Mission energy: 2 min hover, two transitions, cruise
nodes.equation: E_use = E (1 - reserve) ; E_c = E_use - P_hover t_hover - E_tr (1 + back) ; t_cruise = E_c / P_cruise ; range = t_cruise V ; pess: P_hover and E_tr x 1.10, P_cruise,pess ; cross-check with B1 hover

nodes.title: Transition corridor, steady level flight
nodes.equation: for V in 0..22 m/s: T cos(th) = D(a=th), T sin(th) + L = W ; corridor th_lo..th_eq with T = (W - L)/sin(th) <= f T_max(V cos a) ; P_el at T/n ; peaks taken over 0 <= V <= Vcruise
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Forward transition (pitch-over) time simulation
nodes.equation: m dv/dt = T(th) + L + D - W (2-D point mass, dt 0.01 s, semi-implicit Euler) ; th_cmd = max(90 - r t, th_req(V)) ; T holds altitude below V_assist, speed above
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Hover lean, wind limits, landing and ground tip-over

nodes.title: No net knock-down on CLmax
nodes.text: Design CLmax = 1.0 x the critical-section CLmax built on the XFOIL clmax envelope
nodes.basis: XFOIL tends to over-predict clmax at Re 2-3e5 by a few per cent, while the critical-section method under-predicts a low-AR rectangular wing (stall spreads before CL peaks) and the clmax envelope is already the lower of Re 2.3e5 / 3.0e5; the biases offset. nodes.title: Inviscid hinge moment is the bound

nodes.title: APC data transcription check
nodes.equation: Ct' = T / (rho n^2 D^4) ; Cp' = P / (rho n^3 D^5) from the printed N and W ; error = max |Ct'/Ct - 1|, |Cp'/Cp - 1| over rows with Ct, Cp >= 0.02 (4-digit rounding < 0.25 %)

nodes.title: Static operating points, five candidate props
nodes.equation: hover: T_h = k_dl m g / 4 -> rpm, P_shaft from Ct, Cp ; FM = T^1.5 / sqrt(2 rho A) / P_shaft ; full throttle: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q/Kt + I0 (E1 constants, hot winding) ; T/W (bus held, no current limit) = 4 T_max / (k_dl m g) ; rpm limit = K / D_in (APC)

nodes.title: Cruise operating point, five props, all four motors running
nodes.equation: T = m g / (L/D) / 4 ; solve rpm: Ct(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta_p = T V / P_shaft ; P_in = (rpm/Kv + I R) I + P_esc (E1 constants, 25 degC winding) ; total = 4 P_in

nodes.title: Hover download on tube, half-fins, feet and the wing beside the disc
nodes.equation: v_i = sqrt(T / 2 rho A) ; v(x) = v_i (1 + x / sqrt(x^2 + R^2)) ; r_s = R / sqrt(v/v_i) ; D = Cd q d L (tube) + 2 Cf q S (fin) + 0.5 q t h (fin base) + q A (foot) + D_wing ; wing: reach(x) = r_s + mix (x - x_p) ; gap(x) = z_m - reach - z_surf(x) (S5010 upper, and lower for the lower discs) ; where gap < 0 the wetted strip w = 2 sqrt(reach^2 - (z_m - z_surf)^2) carries Cf q/3 (mixing-layer mean of u^2) ; k = 1 + D/T

nodes.title: Slipstream edge versus elevons and wing
nodes.equation: hover: inner edge z = z_m - r_s(x) - mix (x - x_p) ; elevon tip z = c_e sin(delta_max) ; cruise: r_s ~ R (lightly loaded) ; gap = edge - surface

nodes.title: Prop-induced airspeed error at pitot candidates
nodes.equation: v from T = 2 rho A v (V + v) ; four semi-infinite vortex cylinders, gamma = 2 v ; u_x = integral of ring velocities (elliptic K, E) ; error = u_x / V ; grid: Simpson N = 100/200/400, wake length 20/40/80 R

nodes.title: Fin swirl recovery and hover yaw authority
nodes.equation: Gamma_s = Q / (rho v_i pi (R^2 - r_h^2)) ; v_t = Gamma_s / r ; alpha = atan(v_t / v_a) ; CL = 2 pi AR alpha / (2 + sqrt(AR^2 + 4)) (Helmbold) ; M = CL q c h r_cp ; f = M / Q ; yaw per N of differential thrust = (Q/T)(1 - f) + r_arm sin(cant) ; half-fin root moment = F (z_m - r_cp - z_root), z_root = mean S5010 surface over the fin chord

nodes.title: Prop spacing, descent limit, ground effect and tones
nodes.equation: gap_v = 2 z_m - D ; gap_l = 2 y_m - D ; v_h = sqrt(k m g / (8 rho A)) ; V_d,max = 0.28 v_h ; T_IGE/T = 1 / (1 - (R / 4 h)^2) ; M_tip = pi D n / a ; BPF = 2 n

nodes.title: UIUC-measured cross-check of the APC predictions
nodes.equation: static: Ct_UIUC / Ct_APC and Cp_UIUC / Cp_APC at J = 0, top measured rpm ; FM ratio = (Ct ratio)^1.5 / Cp ratio ; cruise: solve Ct_UIUC(J) rho n^2 D^4 = T at V ; eta = T V / P

nodes.title: Unlimited full-throttle rpm on a fresh pack and the output cap that respects the APC limit
nodes.equation: (V - rpm/Kv)/R = Q(rpm)/Kt + I0, cold winding (lowest R, highest rpm), V = max OCV ; cap: find V_eff giving rpm = 0.98 x 105000/D_in ; duty = V_eff / V_ocv,max ; T/W at the cap = 4 T(rpm_cap) / (k_dl m g)

nodes.title: Rotor limit loads per motor and design dive speed
nodes.equation: T_cap = kT_E1 T_h (rpm_cap/rpm_h)^2 ; T_ilim = t_ilim g ; T_lim = max(T_req, T_cap) ; rpm_lim = rpm_h sqrt(T_lim / (kT_E1 T_h)) ; Q = kP_E1 Q_h (rpm_lim/rpm_h)^2 ; H = (m_p D^2/12 + I_bell) omega ; M_gyro = H q_max ; V_pitch = p rpm_cap/60 ; VH = max(V_pitch, VH_B1) ; VD = f_D max(Vc, VH) ; n_hover = n T_lim / (m g)

nodes.title: V-n diagram: manoeuvre and gust envelope
nodes.equation: Vs = sqrt(2W/(rho S CLmax)); VA = Vs sqrt(n+); a = CL_alpha (B2 AVL); mu = 2(W/S)/(rho c a g); kg = 0.88mu/(5.3+mu); dn = kg rho U V a / (2 W/S); n_gust = min(stall line, 1 +/- dn), U = Ude_C to VC then linear to f Ude_C at VD; VD = max(VD_req, VD_C1); design n = max(requirement, gust)

nodes.title: Landing, wingtip strike, tip-over and stance-in-wind loads
nodes.equation: n_L = v^2/(2 g eta s) + 1 - L/W at s = s_min (requirement) and s = foot height (bound) ; s_req = v^2 / (2 g eta (n_target - 1 + L/W)) ; F_foot = m_eff v^2/(2 eta s) + (1 - L/W) W/4 with m_eff = 1/(1/m + (r x n).I^-1.(r x n)) ; wingtip strike roll = atan(foot / (b/2 - y_fin)) ; foot_req = (b/2 - y_fin) tan(attitude) ; tip-over: KE = m g r (1 - cos(phi0 + theta_c)) ; F = KE / (eta s) ; stance wind: q S CD h = W d

nodes.title: Crash factor and pack retention load
nodes.equation: n_c = v^2 / (2 g s) ; F_pack = m_pack_max n_c g (ultimate, emergency)

nodes.title: Box drop load factor
nodes.equation: n_T = 1 + h / (eta s)

nodes.title: Load envelope over every case and both mass configurations
nodes.equation: per case: a = F/m, alpha = I^-1 M_cg ; cut load = sum over the outboard part of (applied + m (g - a - alpha x r)) ; envelope = max over cases F, H, T, L1-L5, G and mass configs MC-C, MC-P ; ultimate = SF x limit ; joints x fitting factor ; transport n_allow = n_T x min(envelope / transport) ; s_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1))

nodes.title: Wing proof load at limit

nodes.title: Motor-station proof load
nodes.procedure: Hang the limit mount load from each motor mount in -x and y with the wing supported at the spar.

nodes.title: Pod-to-wing bond: flight/ground envelope and crash
nodes.equation: loads moved from C1's point (pod centre, base) to the bond centroid: M' = M + (r_ref - r_c) x F; footprint b x L, x 0 ... recess end; sigma = Fz/A + 6|My|/(b L^2) + 6|Mx|/(L b^2) (tension only); tau = |Fxy|/A + |Mz| r_max / J; R = sigma/sigma_a + tau/tau_a; design = limit x SF x k_fit x k_print; crash: m_group n_c g any axis at the group CG, no further factor

nodes.title: Pack stops: aft stop wall (+x), forward stop (-x)
nodes.equation: F_design = max over cases of the pack force x SF x k_fit x k_print; crash F = C1 85 N; sigma = 6 F (h/2) / (b t^2), b = bay + 2 guides; t_req = sqrt(6 F h/2 / (b sigma_a)); nose wall (foam board) as a strip between the side walls: M = F/4 (S - c/2), m_cap = sigma_f t_f (t - t_f) per unit width over the pack height

nodes.title: Bay guides (+-y) and strap legs in a lateral crash
nodes.equation: q = F / L_pack on the guide, resultant at h/2: sigma = 6 q (h/2) / t^2; overturn about the far guide top: T_legs = F (z_pack/2 + pad - h) / w_bay, per strap = T_legs / n

nodes.title: Straps (+z): loop tension, hook-and-loop overlap, tray and floor under the strap
nodes.equation: per strap P = max(F_flight x SF x k_fit x k_print, F_crash) / n; leg T = P/2 + preload/(2n); overlap_req = T / (tau_hl w); tray flat-wise = P / (w_tray (w + 2 s)); front strap on the overhang: floor-to-wall glue line q = P / (2 (w + 2 s)), stress = q / t_board

nodes.title: Pod overhang ahead of the wing LE: section at x = 0

nodes.title: Carry handle on the spar (G1, whole aircraft at 2 g)
nodes.equation: F = m_gate g n_h x SF x k_fit x k_print; ties: F vs n x rating; grip: uniform hand load over the leg span s = 2 y_leg, M = F s / 8, sigma = 6 M / (b h^2)

nodes.title: Bond coupons: epoxy on F-250 and on paper-faced board

nodes.title: Printed stop wall and guide push test
nodes.procedure: Print a 60 mm tray offcut with a 3.0 mm stop wall and 1.5 mm guides, same settings as flight. Push a 50 x 50 mm block at 12 mm height to 90 N (stop) and 85 N spread over 60 mm (guide); no crack, set < 0.5 mm. Then to failure once to learn the allowable.

nodes.title: Built pod on the wing: proof loads with a 680 g dummy pack
nodes.procedure: Wing on its spar ends. Dummy pack (680 g, pack size) strapped in. Pull the dummy pack with a luggage scale at 1.5 x the design value to the slowest-failing direction: down (overhang) 64 N, up 85 N, aft 85 N, sideways 85 N, 10 s each; inspect the bond edges, nose and wall tops for creases.

nodes.basis: PETG bonds peel at a fraction of lap shear; C6 coupons replace it
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: General quad shell element checks
nodes.equation: (a) shell_q4 = shell_element on a 20 x 30 mm rectangle (max relative entry difference); (b) cantilever 0.2 x 0.2 m plate on a 16 x 16 mesh with interior nodes skewed by up to 20 % of an element, f1 vs Leissa lambda^2 = 3.492 (stiff core)

nodes.title: Station modes, D3 as-designed quarter (upper UR and lower LR), nominal E/G
nodes.equation: FE (fin_fe.build_q): tube frame + 1-layer board (mapped Q4 shell) + edge strips + brace (EA/L in series with the anchor) + mount springs + motor/prop/mount rigid body; station mode = >= 10 % of kinetic energy in the rigid body; sep = min |f/f_k - 1| over 1P/2P hover, 1P/2P cruise, 1P cap

nodes.title: Separation over the tube E/G corners and the mount/root stiffness range
nodes.equation: min over side x E {lo, nom, hi} x G {lo, nom, hi} of sep_op (18 FE runs), mount and root at their nominal springs

nodes.title: Mount rocking stiffness needed for the separation rule (governing side)
nodes.equation: sweep k_rock over 500-30 000 N m/rad (k_twist fixed) on both quarters at nominal and low E/G; k_req = smallest k with sep_op >= sep_min at every larger k (log interpolation)

nodes.title: Mesh convergence, D3 quarter (both sides)
nodes.equation: first two station modes at fin meshes 6x5, 12x10 (used), 24x20; change = max |f(12x10)/f(24x20) - 1|

nodes.title: Gyroscopic whirl separation, D3 quarter (both sides)
nodes.equation: M q'' + Omega G q' + K q = 0 on 16 modes, G = -[Ip_spin e_shaft]x at the station; sep over 1P/2P at hover and cruise and 1P at the cap, station whirl modes only

nodes.title: Fin, tube, brace, collar and anchor strength, D3 quarter (both sides)
nodes.equation: FE static, cases L1, L4 (both friction senses), L5, G2 (both senses, n_h m g at the tube end), H2; ultimate = sf x limit (joints x fit x prt); face = Q_f (eps0 + z kappa); brace Pcr = pi^2 E w t^3 / (12 L^2); brace-end bond tau = F / (2 (w + t) engage); collar bond tau = T / (2 pi r^2 h) + F / (pi d h); anchor tau = F / (len_y pi d_spar / 4) vs peel x bond allowable

nodes.title: Through-core block on D3's geometry (bosses not credited for strength)
nodes.equation: as CALC-C4-BLOCK with h = core depth at the tube (z_upper - z_lower at x_t): tube bore s = 6M/(d h^2) + F/(d h); shear-out tau = (1.5 M / h)/(e h), e = (W - d)/2; spar bore s = 6M/(d W^2) + F/(d W); web s = 6M/(W h^2), tau = M/(0.21 W h^2); bond torsion tau = 2 My sf fit prt/(pi d^2 W)

nodes.title: Three-point bend of the US-stock 22 x 20 tube (I1 buys, H1 runs)
nodes.procedure: Span 0.80 m on two 22 mm dowels, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge to 0.01 mm; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta) with I = 3.645e-9 m4. Pass band for the recommended design: E >= 70 GPa.

nodes.title: Torsion of the same tube
nodes.procedure: Clamp 0.40 m of tube in two printed V-blocks at one end, 0.30 m lever arm at the other, 0.5-2 kg, measure twist with a laser pointer on a wall 3 m away; G = T L / (J theta), J = 7.29e-9 m4.

nodes.title: Tap test of one fin quarter (tube + block + half-fin + motor + prop + brace)
nodes.procedure: Block clamped in a vice via a core offcut; tap the motor bell in y and x; phone accelerometer or FC raw IMU at 1 kHz; FFT peaks vs 1P/2P at hover, cruise, max.

nodes.title: Foam-board face coupon
nodes.procedure: Three 50 x 300 mm strips per layer count, four-point bend, span 250 mm, load to failure: face allowable and D. Weigh 0.1 m2 for the areal mass.

nodes.title: Proof load of one fin quarter
nodes.procedure: 1.5 x L4 at the foot (49 N along the fin + 25 N across), then 1.5 x G2 (77 N lateral at the tube end); no cracking or face wrinkle; record the foot deflection.

nodes.title: Block proof in a core offcut
nodes.procedure: Block bonded on a spar stub in a 0.15 m core offcut; 0.30 m tube in the bore; hang 18 kg at 0.17 m lever (30 N m > design 20.3 N m) for 1 min; no creak, no bond line crack.

nodes.title: Bifilar swing of one prop
nodes.procedure: Two 0.5 m threads at the blade tips; period of 20 swings; I = m g d^2 T^2 / (16 pi^2 L).

nodes.title: UN Manual of Tests and Criteria, section 38.3, test T.4 Shock (lithium batteries)
nodes.where: 38.3.4.4: small cells and batteries, half-sine 150 gn peak, 6 ms
nodes.note: every pack shipped as UN3480 must pass T.4; value not yet re-read against the current revision

nodes.title: Touchdown drift 0.3 m/s
nodes.text: Horizontal ground speed at touchdown in QLAND / QLOITER with GPS position hold, any direction
nodes.basis: ArduPilot position hold on a 2-3 kg multirotor typically holds < 0.3 m/s in 5 m/s wind; replace with the twin's landing logs (T-C5-DRIFT-LOG)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Parked-stance factor 1.5
nodes.text: Factor on the overturning moment and on the friction demand before a parked, disarmed aircraft is allowed to stand
nodes.basis: same 1.5 as the structural ultimate factor; the parked case has no pilot to save it

nodes.title: Gust factor 1.4 over the mean
nodes.text: Peak gust / 10-min mean wind at 2 m height at RFS in the morning
nodes.basis: open-terrain gust factors 1.3-1.5 at 2 m; H3 measures it with the handheld anemometer (R-WIND-MEASURE)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Lift coefficient lying flat 0.6
nodes.text: Largest lift coefficient of the wing lying flat on the ground, pod up, any wind direction
nodes.basis: flat plate at 0 deg with a reflexed section, ground effect and a small nose-up rest angle; 0.6 is above any value expected for alpha < 5 deg
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Prop blade half-depth 12 mm turned spanwise
nodes.text: Half the z extent of an 11 in prop blade at the hub region when the blade is turned spanwise
nodes.basis: APC 11x5.5MR hub ~ 10 mm thick, blade chord ~ 25 mm at 5.5 in pitch; measure (H1)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Tube-end cap 5 mm
nodes.text: The motor mount / end cap stands 5 mm beyond the tube end
nodes.basis: A1 envelope note (transport.envelope_props_off_m: tube ends +/-0.21 plus ~5 mm mount caps)

nodes.title: Pack deceleration limit 100 g
nodes.text: Largest pack deceleration accepted in the survivable crash, applied through foam over the full fore face (no point load)
nodes.basis: UN 38.3 T.4 shock 150 gn on every shipped pack, / 1.5
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pod nose wall 2 mm
nodes.text: Thickness of the pod nose skin ahead of the crush block
nodes.basis: foam board or printed shell (D2)

nodes.title: Drop-test stroke guard 3 mm
nodes.text: Stroke that must remain unused at the end of the design drop (scatter of the XPS plateau)
nodes.basis: 10 % of the 32 mm stroke

nodes.title: CG cases and static tip-over on the fin-tip feet
nodes.equation: CG from A3 items (feet replaced by D5's mass at x = c + foot/2) ; flying cases: pack slid until x_cg = B3 target / forward / aft limit (CR-B3-11), pack 503 / 550 / 680 g ; h = c + foot - x_cg ; narrow(+z) = atan((z_pad - z_cg) / h), narrow(-z) = atan((z_pad + z_cg) / h) ; wide = atan(y_fin / h) ; residual thrust T = lam W along the body: tip at acos(lam z/R) - atan(h/z), R = hypot(z, h) ; lam_max(err) = R cos(err + atan(h/z)) / z

nodes.title: Tip-over, unsplayed feet, R1 CG with z offset
nodes.how: Tilting board, feet at the fin tips without splay (first build before D5's pads): angle toward the pod side.

nodes.title: Landing lean, drift allowance and parked-stance wind limits
nodes.equation: lean = atan(q S CD90 / (m g)), S = b c broadside or 4 fin_c fin_hh span-along-wind ; v_allow(phi) = sqrt(2 g (R - b_phi)(k^2 + R^2)) / b_phi, b_phi = z sin phi + h cos phi ; delta(v) = beta - phi(v_allow = v) ; beta_req = lean(5) + err + delta(v_td) ; V_tip = sqrt(2 m g z_arm / (h_cp rho S CD90)), h_cp = c/2 + foot ; V_slide = sqrt(2 mu m g / (rho S CD90)) ; V_park = min(V_tip, V_slide)/sqrt(SF) ; V_lift,flat = sqrt(2 m g / (rho S CL_flat))

nodes.title: Single-foot drop rig
nodes.procedure: A foot (shoe bonded on a 2-layer foam-board offcut clamped vertical) under a 0.65 kg sled on two guide rods; free drop 0.115 m onto plywood; phone or logger accelerometer on the sled. 3 drops, new cartridge each. Pass: stroke <= 29 mm, sled peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz filter), no shoe-bond crack. Run before the aircraft drop; cheap and repeatable.

nodes.title: Aircraft drop at 1.5 m/s (= T-C1-FOOT-DROP)
nodes.procedure: Complete aircraft, props off, LiPo replaced by a 550 g sandbag (add ballast to 2.6 kg), FC powered from a small 2S pack logging IMU at >= 1 kHz (or a strapped logger at the CG). Hang from a quick-release at 0.115 m pad-to-floor over plywood. Drops: level x2; 10 deg pitch (one pad pair first); 10 deg roll (one fin first); 10 deg pitch + roll (one foot first). New cartridges before each level drop. Pass: CG peak <= 6.0 g (100 Hz low-pass), every stroke <= 29 mm, the wing TE does not touch in the level and pitch drops (the protected wingtip corner may touch in the roll and corner drops), no damage beyond the cartridges (shoe bonds, fin tips, tube block, pod bond checked).

nodes.title: Foot stack and sizes
nodes.equation: x_g = c + foot ; flange = x_g - pad - t_fl ; sleeve end = flange - stroke ; piston open = sleeve end - engage ; back wall = open - stroke - 1 mm ; L_cart = flange - back wall ; sections: cartridge + 2 cf -> piston + 2 w -> sleeve + 2 cs + 2 w ; z_eff = z_outer - r ; TE clearance at full stroke = foot - stroke

nodes.title: Constant-force crush of one landing
nodes.equation: F_p = sigma fy fz ; F_pk = k F_p ; KE = m v^2 / 2 ; 4 F_p (s - eps_y L / 2) = KE + (1 - lam) m g s ; eta = 4 F_p (s - eps_y L/2) / (4 F_pk s) ; n_L = 4 F_pk / (m g) ; strain = s / L ; normal set = max(0, (m v_n^2/2 - 4 F_p eps_y L / 2) / (4 F_p))

nodes.procedure: Crush 3 cartridge pairs in a printed piston + shoe on a drill-press over a kitchen scale (or the H1 thrust-stand load cell), 30 mm at < 10 mm/s; record force every 2 mm. Pass: plateau 30-37 N, peak <= 38 N. Off target: change cartridge.section_z_m by the force ratio and re-run feet_calc.py.

nodes.title: Pad slide on a tilt board
nodes.procedure: Foot with pad, 0.65 kg on it, on a board faced with concrete paver / asphalt shingle / turf; tilt until it slides; mu = tan(angle). Pass >= 0.7 dry.

nodes.title: Timed foot-insert swap

nodes.title: Packs travel outside the box
nodes.text: Flight packs ride in a LiPo bag (E2), not in the box; the aircraft in the box is the gate mass less one pack
nodes.basis: LiPo transport practice (E2 owns); keeps the loaded box under 6 kg

nodes.title: Design drop is flat on the floor
nodes.text: The 0.3 m sill drop is designed for a flat floor impact; side, end and corner impacts are checked by test only
nodes.basis: a box slipping off a sill lands on its floor or a bottom edge; edge drops rotate the box and load less (ISTA practice)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Cradle crush column: stroke, load factor, free travel
nodes.equation: s_use = eps_use t ; n_T = 1 + h / (eta s_use) ; s_bottom = eps_bottom t ; travel_req = s_bottom + margin ; t_req = h / (eta (n_allow - 1) eps_use)

nodes.title: Box stack-up: height needed, clearances, drop allowed by the 0.50 m box
nodes.equation: floor = shell + doubler ; lid = shell + lining ; H_req = floor + travel_req + env_z + gap_min + lid ; travel = H - floor - lid - env_z - gap_min ; clear_bottoming = travel - s_bottom ; x_clear = (W - 2 shell - env_x) / 2 ; tip_to_pad = (L - 2 shell - env_y) / 2 - pad ; A1 box: t_max = (travel_A1 - margin) / eps_bottom, h_allow = (n_allow - 1) eta eps_use t_max

nodes.title: Static stress on the crush columns
nodes.equation: sigma = (m_gate - m_pack) g / (2 a b)

nodes.title: Box mass and loaded mass
nodes.equation: shell = areal (1 + flaps) [L W + 2 (L + W)(H - t) + L W + 2 (L + W) lip] ; box = shell + doublers + lining + pads + cradles + tray + straps + handles + corners + consumables ; loaded = box + (gate - pack) + spare props + pouch

nodes.title: Field set-up time, closed box to the arm check
nodes.equation: T = sum(step seconds) / 60

steps: open box: 2 cam straps, lift lid (hold-down pillars come with it)
lift aircraft by the centre section, stand it on its feet on the mat
take props, pitot boom and pouch from the tray
fit 4 props, CW/CCW colour-matched to the motor
plug in the pitot boom, check the tubes
take a pack from the LiPo bag, seat it, strap it
close the pack plug, FC boots

nodes.title: Pack-current limit 100 A
nodes.text: ArduPilot Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX = 100 A (with the power module's current sensor calibrated) caps the summed motor current
nodes.basis: 4 x 25 A = the X3108S's 25 A / 30 s rating; F4 sets it, F1 sizes wiring to it

nodes.title: Transition thrust margin 1.3
nodes.text: full thrust at every point of the level pitch-over corridor >= 1.3 x the thrust that holds level unaccelerated flight there
nodes.basis: 0.3 g of surplus for acceleration and gusts; same headroom as ASM-A2-GUST-THRUST-HEADROOM

nodes.title: Wing CL: linear to CLmax, flat plate after stall
nodes.text: CL = a alpha up to CLmax (a = 2 pi AR/(AR+2)); above stall CN = 1.98 sin(alpha) (flat plate); prop wash on the wing ignored
nodes.basis: Hoerner flat-plate normal force; ignoring wash lift is conservative for thrust required; B1/B2 refine

nodes.title: Worst pack state for hover T/W
nodes.text: the lowest pack state the aircraft is flown in: the 20 % reserve line (E2 ASM-E2-OCV-20), pack cold-soaked to 10 degC (E2 ASM-E2-COLD-R), windings hot (80 degC, after a hover), 100 A limiter set; pack resistance = cells x R_cell x cold + R_ext (E2's model)
nodes.basis: one definition shared with E2 (CR-E2/E1 reconciliation 2026-11-09); the battery failsafe lands the aircraft at the reserve line, so states below it are emergencies, reported as a sensitivity (3.60 V/cell OCV)

nodes.title: Motor-to-mount screw stack
nodes.text: D3 mount plate 5.0 mm thick at the screw bosses, no washer, M3x8 SHCS (A2 stainless, same size as the old design's F01); thread engagement in the motor base 2.5-3.5 mm (>= 5 threads, tip clear of the stator)
nodes.basis: X3108S base thread depth is not published: 3.5 mm is a conservative limit for a 31 mm stator base; probe the hole depth on arrival, the screw tip must stop >= 0.5 mm short of the bottom
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Per-unit flying masses incl. leads, g
nodes.text: motor with factory leads 81.0 (no bullets: harness HRN-E03); ESC with factory power and signal leads and heat-shrink 11.0 (6.6 g bare board + 2 x 80 mm 16 AWG + signal lead + shrink); prop 17.0; bolt-on adapter 3.0 + 4 x M3x4 1.2 + M6 nut 1.9 + washer 0.6 = 6.7; 4 x M3x8 SHCS motor screws 3.2
nodes.basis: listings (81 g, 17 g, 3.0 g); ISO masses for screws, nuts, washers; the ESC with leads is EST from the 6.6 g bare board and 14 g/m 16 AWG silicone (A3 HRN-E01); weigh everything on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Fit PER3 to the maker's X3108S + 11x4.7 table
nodes.equation: kT = mean(T_meas / T_PER3(rpm)) ; kP: sum(P_bat,model(rpm) - P_meas) = 0 over rows 5-12 A ; R_th = (94 - 25) / P_loss(30 A row)

nodes.title: Hover operating point per motor, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR
nodes.equation: T_m = m_gate g k_dl / (4 cos cant) ; solve rpm: T(rpm) = T_m ; I_bat, P_bat at V_bus = 14.8 V ; g/W = T_m / g / P_bat ; dT_wind = R_th P_loss

nodes.title: Full-throttle static thrust and current, all four motors
nodes.equation: duty = 1 ; V_bus = V_ocv - R_pack (4 I_bat + I_avn) ; T/W = 4 T_max / (m_gate g) ; cases: table basis (bus held 14.8 V, 25 degC), sag (OCV 14.4 V, R_pack, 80 degC), current limits (bus held 14.8 / 16.8 V, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Full throttle with the pack-current limiter Q_M_BAT_CURR_MAX
nodes.equation: largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim ; T/W = 4 T / (m_gate g) ; cases fresh (OCV 16.8 V, 25 degC) and low (OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC), with R_pack

nodes.title: Hover T/W at the worst pack state (E1 station model + E2 pack model)
nodes.equation: R_pack = cells R_cell k_cold + R_ext ; V_ocv = cells OCV ; largest duty with 4 I_bat + I_avn <= I_lim (station model, winding 80 degC) ; T/W = 4 T cos(cant) / (m_gate g) ; f_sag = T_worst / T_fresh (fresh: 4.20 V/cell, warm R, 25 degC)

nodes.title: Prop stack: mount face to prop plane, nut engagement, motor screws
nodes.equation: x_hub = L_body + t_base + h_hub / 2 ; x_tip = L_body + t_base + L_post ; e_nut = L_post - h_hub - t_washer >= h_nut ; e_screw = L_screw - t_plate

nodes.title: Propulsion flying mass, four stations, per-unit masses incl. leads
nodes.equation: m = n (motor + ESC + prop + adapter and nut + motor screws)

nodes.title: Cruise point: four props share the drag at 15 m/s
nodes.equation: D = q S (CD0 + K CL^2), CD0 from L/D 5.9 at 15 m/s ; T_m = D / 4 ; solve rpm: T(rpm, J) = T_m ; eta_prop = T V / P_shaft ; eta_tot = T V / P_bat

nodes.title: Thrust margin along the level pitch-over corridor (sag case, 11x4.5MR and 11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: min over V in [0, 1.3 Vs] of 4 T_full(V cos a, OCV 14.4 V, 80 degC) / T_req,min(V) ; T_req from T sin a + L = W, T cos a >= D

nodes.title: One motor out: what is left (11x5.5MR)
nodes.equation: hover: thrust/moment balance forces the diagonal partner to 0 -> 2 same-direction motors, T/W_2 = 2 T_max,worst / W, unbalanced yaw torque = 2 Q_hover ; cruise: 2 motors carry D, roll torque = 2 Q(T = D/2) for elevons to hold

nodes.title: Lower bound: pure PER3 power (kP = 1)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E1-HOVER and CALC-E1-CRUISE with kP = 1, kT = 1

nodes.title: Cruise mass scaling, circuit factor and independent cross-check model
nodes.text: The cruise power LEVEL is B1's (CL-B1-CRUISE-P / -P-PESS, level flight at the gate, avionics included). This E2 drag model (CD0 0.0593, x1.3 pessimistic, e from params, eta_prop 0.47 / 0.35, eta_motor 0.72, trim 1.05) only scales B1's power from the gate to another mass, and is reported as a cross-check. The turning (circuit) factor 1.05 multiplies B1's level-flight power

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, base case (sized mass)
nodes.equation: I = (Voc - sqrt(Voc^2 - 4 R P)) / (2 R) per phase ; Ah = I t ; P_cruise = P_B1(gate) x circuit x P_E2(m) / P_E2(gate) ; t_cruise = (C - 0.2 C - sum Ah_fixed) / I_cruise
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, pessimistic (2.6 kg gate)

nodes.title: Full-throttle bus voltage and thrust factor vs pack state
nodes.equation: V = Voc - R I_full (V/V_tab)^2 ; thrust factor = (V/V_tab)^2 ; T/W = n T_max f / m_gate

nodes.title: Pack self-heating over the pessimistic mission, cold and hot mornings
nodes.equation: Q = sum(I^2 R t) over phases ; dT = Q / (m c) (adiabatic, c = 1000 J/kg K) ; T_end = T_amb + dT ; cold: 10 degC, R x 1.5 ; hot: 30 degC, R x 1.0

nodes.title: Pack trade: candidates against the gate and the pessimistic mission
nodes.equation: m = m_sized - m_pack_baseline + m_cand ; pessimistic at m + (gate - m_sized) ; pass = m <= gate AND t_cruise_pess >= 5 min AND I_cont >= I_full
reasons: does not re-run to its stored outputs (see build errors)

nodes.title: Battery failsafe thresholds for the flight controller
nodes.equation: CRT_MAH = reserve C ; LOW_MAH = CRT + Ah(back-transition + descent + 60 s return cruise + 30 s landing hover), pessimistic currents, rounded up to 100 mAh

nodes.title: Indicative: B1's cruise power scaled to the 11x5.5MR by E1's prop ratio

nodes.title: Flight pack mass carried in the budget (not yet weighed)
nodes.how: Weigh each pack on arrival on a 1 g scale (T-E2-WEIGH) and enter it in pack_log.csv, then re-run; listings say 522-551 g, one 680 g. Accept <= 0.68 kg (A3's growth bound); 0.55-0.68 kg: A3 updates the roll-up; > 0.68 kg: return the pack and buy another SKU.

nodes.title: Weigh and measure every pack on arrival
nodes.procedure: 1 g scale; calipers L x W x H incl. lead exit; one row per pack (E2-P1, E2-P2) in redesign/team/E2/pack_log.csv, then re-run this script and build_graph.py.

nodes.title: Discharge capacity test at 1C
nodes.procedure: Charger discharge mode is limited in power: discharge through the thrust stand at ~6.5 A to 3.5 V/cell under load, log mAh with the watt meter; pass >= 6.0 Ah (R-PACK-MASS).

nodes.title: Pack resistance by load step
nodes.procedure: Thrust stand, one motor: rest voltage, then 20 A step; R = dV / dI after 2 s; repeat at 10 degC (pack 1 h in a fridge, bagged). Pass <= 5 mOhm/cell at 25 degC.

nodes.title: Full-mission current log
nodes.procedure: DataFlash BAT messages; IR thermometer on pack before/after; compare row by row with the phase table.

nodes.title: Incropera, DeWitt et al., Fundamentals of Heat and Mass Transfer, 6th ed.
nodes.where: eq. 7.30 laminar flat plate Nu = 0.664 Re^0.5 Pr^1/3; eq. 9.27 natural convection; Table A.4 air at 300 K (nu 15.89e-6 m2/s, k 0.0263 W/m K, Pr 0.707); Table 1.1 film-coefficient ranges
reasons: value never compared with the source (no 'checked' date)

nodes.title: Prusament PETG technical data sheet (HDT 68 degC at 0.45 and 1.8 MPa)

nodes.title: Prusament ASA technical data sheet v1.1 (May 2024)

nodes.title: Silicon Labs EFM8BB21F16G-C-QFN20 (BLHeli_S ESC MCU) temperature grade
nodes.where: 'G' grade -40 to +85 degC operating (Silicon Labs device page; Arrow, Farnell listings agree). The LANRC 45 A ESC publishes no temperature rating

nodes.title: STM32F405RGT6 ambient rating -40 to +85 degC (6-suffix)

nodes.title: LiPo discharge temperature rating 60 degC (hobby pack norm)

nodes.title: Air properties at 300 K
nodes.text: kinematic viscosity, conductivity, Prandtl number used in every film coefficient
nodes.basis: Incropera Table A.4; within +-6 % from 10 to 40 degC, so held constant

nodes.title: Motor specific heat 540 J/kg K
nodes.text: one lumped node of 81 g: copper ~20 g, laminations ~25 g, aluminium bell and base ~20 g, magnets and shaft ~16 g
nodes.basis: mass-weighted c_p (Cu 385, Fe 450, Al 900, NdFeB 440, steel 470) = 520-560
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance 1.5 K/W (design)
nodes.text: winding-to-ambient resistance in its own prop wash used for the design case; E1's 1.0 K/W is the nominal case
nodes.basis: E1 back-solved 0.83 K/W from the maker's 94 degC at the 30 A row, a test that was probably not steady, so the true value is higher; an outer-surface-only correlation (rotating bell, no internal ventilation) gives ~3 K/W, a bound. 1.5 x nominal until T-E3-MOTOR-TAU
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC body 45 x 20 x 6 mm, 11 g, 700 J/kg K
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A in heat-shrink, strapped flat on the fin pad, FET side out; the pad face is adiabatic (foam board); the leads' fin effect is ignored (conservative)
nodes.basis: typical 45 A BLHeli_S 2-6S board size (LANRC publishes no drawing); mass from E1's 11 g with leads (ASM-E1-PART-MASS); c_p FR4 + copper + parts. Measure on arrival
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: ESC pad centre at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the motor axis (D3 layout)
nodes.text: pad FIN-007 on the half-fin face from x 0.078 to 0.124 m, centre |z| 0.118 m (72 mm toward the wing from the motor axis), ESC long side along x; the 20 mm wide ESC spans 62-82 mm from the axis
nodes.basis: subsystems/fins/params.json fin_detail.esc_pad (x0 0.078, len 0.046, z 0.118; D3 R2, CL-D3-ESC-WASH), which replaces E3's R1 proposal (x 0.10, 60 mm). Inside the contracted slipstream, clear of the hub wake (r < 30 mm)

nodes.title: Hook-and-loop strap covers 320 mm2 of the ESC's exposed faces
nodes.text: one 10 mm strap through the two pad slots wraps the ESC once: it covers 10 mm x (20 + 2 x 6) mm of the FET face and sides, which then reject no heat (conservative)
nodes.basis: fins BUILD.md / params fin_detail.esc_pad.slot_m (10 mm strap); ESC 45 x 20 x 6 (ASM-E3-ESC): exposed 1 680 mm2 -> 1 360 mm2 (-19 %)

nodes.title: Local-velocity factor at the ESC 0.7 nominal / 0.5 design
nodes.text: velocity over the ESC = factor x the slipstream (hover) or free-stream (cruise) velocity, for the motor-tube wake and the fin boundary layer
nodes.basis: the pad is 2.5 tube diameters behind the 22 mm tube, on its wake centreline; a cylinder wake keeps a 0.3-0.5 velocity deficit there; the 6 mm ESC sits inside a 3-6 mm fin boundary layer. Measure with a hot-wire or the ESC temperature on the stand (T-E3-ESC-PAD)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Emissivity 0.9, still-air film 8 W/m2 K
nodes.text: heat-shrink, solder mask, anodised and painted surfaces; natural convection on small parts with no flow
nodes.basis: Incropera Table 1.1 (free convection, gases 2-25); radiation linearised at the part temperature

nodes.title: Pack c_p 1 000 J/kg K, cell R 5 mOhm design, R(T) x 1.5 per 15 K below 25 degC
nodes.text: pack heat = I^2 x cells x R_cell(T); R_cell = 4 mOhm nominal (E2), 5 mOhm design (E2's T-E2-IR acceptance limit); R(T) = R25 x 1.5^((25 - T)/15) below 25 degC, R25 above (no credit for warm cells)
nodes.basis: E2 ASM-E2-R-CELL, ASM-E2-COLD-R and T-E2-IR pass value; c_p as E2 (LiPo 1 000-1 100)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Flight controller 2.0 W, 50 x 36 mm, 20 J/K
nodes.text: FC board dissipation: MCU, IMU/baro, OSD and its 5 V regulator (servo BEC in a separate UBEC); board both faces exchange with the pod air
nodes.basis: previous design itemisation 2.0 W (docs/research/thermal.md section 2); F405 wing boards 50-54 x 32-36 mm; F3 replaces with the bench current
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pod shell and vents
nodes.text: shell foam board 5 mm, k 0.035 W/m K, the face on the wing adiabatic; pod air 10 J/K; recommended vents: inlet 15 x 30 mm at the pod nose and an equal exit at the rear, internal velocity 0.25 x airspeed in cruise, no vent flow credited in hover
nodes.basis: foam board k 0.03-0.04; vent sizing as the previous design (docs/research/thermal.md 6.4); 0.25 for inlet and internal losses EST

nodes.title: Mission order and hover split
nodes.text: chronological order of E2's phases: ground, climb, first hover (half of the hover row), forward transition, cruise, back-transition, second hover, descent; motors off on the ground; climb, hover, transitions and descent use the static prop law; the abuse case adds 30 s at the 100 A limiter after the first hover
nodes.basis: mission profile params.json#mission.profile; E2 ASM-E2-PROFILE; E1 CR-E1-10 (full throttle <= 30 s)

nodes.title: Temperature limits
nodes.text: motor winding/stator 80; PETG mount HDT 68; ASA mount HDT 93; ESC 85; pack 60 rating and 50 at landing for life; FC 85 degC
nodes.basis: motor: previous test-plan abort value (SunnySky publishes none; the maker's own test reached 94 degC); PETG and ASA: TDS HDT at 0.45 MPa; ESC: EFM8BB21 G-grade MCU; pack: hobby LiPo rating (E2 uses 50 at landing); FC: STM32F405 and IMU rating
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Morning sun 700 W/m2, absorptivity 0.9 dark / 0.3 white, outside film 20 W/m2 K, 600 s soak
nodes.text: parked aircraft at set-up, sun on the pod top
nodes.basis: clear April morning 09-10 h; Incropera Table 1.1; five-minute set-up plus waiting
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Ambient sweep 15, 20, 25, 30 degC
nodes.text: field ambients at which every temperature is reported for the mission table; the pack starts at ambient (E2's >= 20 degC warm-up rule is not modelled, so the 15 degC row is a cold-pack row)
nodes.basis: E3 task scope 2026-11-09 (15-30 degC); params env.ambient_design_c is [10, 30] and its cold end stays in CL-E3-PACK-RISE-COLD

nodes.title: H1 GT-04 stand sequence
nodes.text: one station on the stand with the ESC on the half-fin mock-up: 120 s at 690 gf hover thrust, 10 s at the 25 A limiter share, 60 s at hover thrust, then stop; no forward flow
nodes.basis: team/H1/GROUND-TEST-PLAN.md GT-04 step 1 (CR-H1-06)

nodes.title: Mission temperatures at the top of the design ambient (30 degC)
nodes.equation: per node C dT/dt = Q(t, T) - sum G (T - T_neighbour) ; Q_motor = I_m^2 R_m(T) + I0 n/Kv, Q_esc = I_m^2 R_esc + P_fix with I_m from P_bus = I_m (n/Kv + I_m R_m) + Q_esc and Q = kP Q_B4 (n/n_B4)^2 ; ESC h = 0.664 Re^0.5 Pr^1/3 k/L at f_wake v(x), v(x) = v_i (1 + x/sqrt(x^2+R^2)) + 4 eps sigma T^3 ; pack Q = I^2 N R_cell(T) ; explicit Euler dt 0.5 s, pod air relaxed exactly

nodes.title: Field-ambient ceiling per part (design case, mission and hover-only sortie)
nodes.equation: T_amb,max(part) = max T_amb such that peak T_part(T_amb) <= limit (bisection on the full model) ; ceiling = min over parts ; pack starts at ambient

nodes.title: Model checks: time-step convergence, steady hover vs hand value, pack vs E2
nodes.equation: convergence: peaks at dt 1.0 / 0.5 / 0.25 s ; steady: T_mot - T_amb -> Q_m R_th after 15 tau ; pack: adiabatic, R x 1.0 at 30 degC and x 1.5 at 10 degC, E2 phase order -> E2's dT

nodes.title: Pre-flight sun soak of the pack in the pod
nodes.equation: T_sol-air - T_amb = alpha G / h_o ; Q = G_top (T_sa - T_amb), G_top = A_top / (t/k + 1/h_o) ; dT_pack <= Q t / (m c) (all of it reaching the pack: upper bound)

nodes.title: Operating limits: full-throttle burst length and pack start temperature (design, 30 degC)
nodes.equation: burst: max t such that peak T_motor <= 80 degC and T_esc <= 85 degC with t s at the limiter after the first hover ; pack: max T_start such that T_pack(landing) <= 50 degC (bisection)

nodes.title: Mission temperatures across the 15-30 degC field ambient (design and nominal)
nodes.equation: as CALC-E3-MISSION, repeated at each ambient of ASM-E3-AMB-SWEEP ; rows [T_amb, motor peak, ESC peak, pack at landing, FC peak, pod-air peak] in degC

nodes.title: Predicted rises for the H1 GT-04 stand sequence (CR-H1-06)
nodes.equation: rpm from thrust n = n_B4 sqrt(T / (kT T_B4)) ; bus power from the motor model at 25 degC ; RC network of CALC-E3-MISSION with the static slipstream, sequence ASM-E3-GT04 ; rise = T - T_amb at stop (what the IR reads) ; scaled-to-30 degC = T_meas - T_amb,test + 30

nodes.title: Motor thermal resistance and time constant on the thrust stand
nodes.procedure: One station on the H1 stand with the real printed mount, 11x5.5MR, 14.8 V. K-type thermocouples on the stator (through the base vent), between base and mount, and on the bell (IR). From ambient: hover power (~100 W bus) for 10 min, log every 5 s; fit T = T_inf - (T_inf - T_0) e^(-t/tau): R_th = (T_inf - T_amb) / loss, loss = P_in - torque x omega. Then 30 s at 24.8 A. Pass: R_th <= 1.5 K/W, base < 58 degC at hover power from 30 degC (PETG) or < 83 degC (ASA).

nodes.title: ESC on a fin-pad mock-up in the slipstream
nodes.procedure: Foam-board half-fin with a 22 mm tube LE behind the stand prop; ESC strapped on the pad at x 0.101 m, 0.072 m from the axis, FET side out; thermocouple under the heat-shrink on the FETs. Hover power 10 min, then 30 s at the limiter. Tuft on the pad. Back-solve the wake factor: f = (h_meas / h_model)^2. Pass: <= 70 degC steady at hover power from 30 degC (15 K below the MCU rating).

nodes.title: Temperatures after the first full missions
nodes.procedure: Field ambient from the handheld anemometer/thermometer at take-off; IR on the four motor cans, ESCs and the pack within 60 s of landing; IMU.T and BAT current from the log. Compare with the model re-run at the measured ambient: within +-8 K, else update ASM-E3-RTH-DESIGN / ASM-E3-WAKE.

nodes.basis: typical maker tables (BNTECHGO, Turnigy) +/-0.2 mm; measure the reel
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Cooling derates
nodes.text: [f_pod, f_channel, f_pair, emissivity]: f_pod 1.0 in the vented pod (still air); f_channel 0.75 for a lead in a tape-covered surface groove in the wing; f_pair 0.85 for a twisted +/- pair (pod only; in the wing + and - lie in two grooves 5 mm apart, f 1.0); silicone emissivity 0.9
nodes.basis: engineering judgement: a covered groove halves convection but keeps radiation to the tape and foam (~0.75 overall); a twisted pair shields ~15 % of each conductor's surface. Prop wash over the wing in hover is not credited. T-F1-WIRE-HEAT measures it
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Short-time wire temperature rise limit 30 degC
nodes.text: conductor rise <= 30 degC for any case shorter than 60 s
nodes.basis: keeps the conductor <= 60 degC at the 30 degC ambient ceiling: 14 degC under the XPS service limit (~74 degC) and 20 degC under PETG Tg; silicone itself is rated 200 degC. P18's 10 degC applies to the continuous current (CR-F1-01 asks A2 to state this)

nodes.title: Contact resistance per mated contact
nodes.text: AS150U contact 0.8 mOhm (two in the path)
nodes.basis: reseller values 0.40 and <= 0.8 mOhm; the larger is used
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Current shunt, board copper and solder joints
nodes.text: 0.6 mOhm in the common path (sensor shunt ~0.25, copper and four solder joints ~0.35)
nodes.basis: typical 0.2-0.3 mOhm hobby PDB shunts; measured by T-F1-DROP
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Servo stall current 1.3 A at 6 V
nodes.text: per elevon servo, 17-20 g metal-gear class
nodes.basis: ES3054HV listing max current 1.3 A; micro metal-gear servos 1.0-1.5 A; measured by T-F1-SERVO-STALL on the servo D6 picks
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Current-sensor tolerance 5 %
nodes.text: BATT_AMP_PERVLT calibrated within +/-5 % at 24-30 A (R-AVIONICS-POWER)
nodes.basis: requirement value; the 100 A limiter acts on the sensed current

nodes.title: Bus capacitance per ESC 1 000 uF
nodes.text: LANRC 45 A input capacitor plus the added low-ESR 680 uF at each ESC (0.5 m leads)
nodes.basis: leads beyond ~0.15 m need added capacitance at the ESC; value = ripple practice, checked by T-F1-RIPPLE

nodes.title: Design currents for the pack path
nodes.equation: I_cont = max(I_hover, I_cruise, P_vclimb / V_nom) ; I_short = max profile phase <= 60 s ; I_req = k I

nodes.title: Wire derating: steady rise, mission-profile peak, drop, mass
nodes.equation: see module docstring; ESC lead current = I_pack / n x 2s/(1+s) (heavier pair at the hover split s); drop = I (R_contacts + R_board + 2 L R'(T)) / V_nom

nodes.title: UBEC efficiency 0.85
nodes.text: switching UBEC, 4S in, 6 V out
nodes.basis: typical buck converter at 1-5 A

nodes.title: Pack's own leads: gauge and length after re-termination
nodes.text: [assumed maker gauge AWG, alternative gauge AWG, length one way m]
nodes.basis: the Ovonic listing does not give the lead gauge (open the product sheet / measure); 4S 6500 130C packs ship with 10 or 12 AWG. Length: D2 CR-D2-07 needs >= 90 mm from the pack aft face to the parked connector; cut to 0.10 m when the AS150U is fitted
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Pack lead steady rise limit 20 degC
nodes.text: steady conductor rise <= 20 degC at the continuous design current for the pack's own leads
nodes.basis: the leads are bought with the pack and conduct heat into the cells: conductor <= 50 degC at the 30 degC ambient ceiling keeps the cell tabs under the 60 degC LiPo discharge limit. P18's 10 degC applies to the aircraft-side wiring F1 sizes (CR-F1-15 asks A2 to state the scope)

nodes.title: Pack's own leads: steady and mission-peak rise
nodes.equation: same wire model as CALC-F1-WIRES, pod still air, side-by-side pair (f_pair)

nodes.title: Servo supply requirement
nodes.equation: I_req = k_bec x n_servo x I_stall

nodes.title: Anti-spark pre-charge time
nodes.equation: tau = R_pre x n x C_esc ; 3 tau to 95 % ; I_inrush = V_full / R_pre

nodes.title: APC 11x4.5MR static thrust per rpm^2 (superseded)
nodes.text: Static thrust of the 11x4.5MR scales as T = kT n^2 with kT = 7.254 N / 6000^2 rpm^2 (APC PER3 file)
nodes.basis: APC PER3 static rows: 5.02 N at 5000, 7.25 N at 6000, 9.91 N at 7000 rpm (within 2 % of n^2 scaling). Superseded by D-05 (flight prop 11x5.5MR): J1's forcing frequencies now read B4's CL-B4-HOVER-RPM / CL-B4-CRUISE-RPM; kept only because team/C1/claims.json still names it (C1 re-runs loads.py, CR-J1-10)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Prop efficiency at ~1 N per prop, 15 m/s (11x4.5MR, superseded)
nodes.text: The 11x4.5MR at 15 m/s and ~1 N thrust runs at J ~0.50-0.53, close to its zero-thrust J ~0.545, with eta 0.30-0.45
nodes.basis: APC PER3 rows: eta 0.17 at 6000 rpm / 14.7 m/s (0.32 N) and 0.54 at 7000 rpm / 14.4 m/s (2.38 N); 1 N lies between. Superseded by D-05: the flight prop is the 11x5.5MR, B4 CL-B4-CRUISE-ETA 0.46 and E1 CL-E1-CRUISE-ETA-55 0.39 (B4 CL-B4-CRUISE-ETA-OLD 0.37 for the 11x4.5MR confirms this band)
reasons: assumption marked UNVERIFIED by its author

nodes.title: Fin side-area centroid vs CG
nodes.equation: arm = (x_le + x_te)/2 - x_cg ; ahead = max(0, (x_cg - x_le)/(x_te - x_le)) ; arm_c = arm / c

nodes.title: Prop plane ahead of the CG
nodes.equation: arm = x_cg - x_prop ; arm_c = arm / c

nodes.title: Bare motor-tube first bending mode
nodes.equation: I = pi/64 (od^4 - id^4) ; k = 3 E I / L^3 ; m_eff = m_motor + m_prop + m_mount + 0.24 mu L ; f1 = sqrt(k/m_eff) / 2 pi

nodes.title: Motor forcing frequencies at the three steady rpm
nodes.equation: f1P = rpm/60 ; f2P = 2 f1P (2-blade) at hover (B4), cruise (B4) and the capped full-throttle rpm

nodes.title: Tube mode separation from motor forcing
nodes.equation: sep = min |f1/f - 1| over f in {1P, 2P} x {hover, cruise, max rpm}

nodes.title: Static margin trimmable with elevons neutral (S5010)
nodes.equation: CL = m g / (0.5 rho V^2 S) ; sigma_trim = cm0 / CL  (Hepperle: Cm = CL sigma for a plank)

nodes.title: Fin centroid aft of CG
nodes.how: B3: AVL Cn_beta >= P:requirements.cnbeta_min with fins, tubes and props at R1 geometry (CL-B3-CNB re-run). Flight: FBWA yaw doublet on the twin; no growing yaw oscillation hands-off.
nodes.note: Geometry screen only, not Cn_beta. With the tubes through the wing at x 0.045 (D-04) the fin centroid is 0.14 m (43 % chord) aft of the CG and no fin area is ahead of it; at R0 it was 0.04 m with 40 % ahead. This is the geometric reason B3's option O4b turned Cn_beta from -0.105 to +0.044 /rad. The FW yaw actuator question (CR-J1-05, F4) stands: Plane has no FW yaw stabilisation by default.

nodes.title: Tube mode separation from forcing
nodes.how: C4 re-derives with the half-fin as a bonded shear web (CR-J1-03 / CR-B4-07); H1 tap test; hover VIBE < P:requirements.fc_vibe_max_ms2 and Clip = 0 (SRC-J1-AP-VIBE).
nodes.note: FAILS on the bare tube: f1 ~183 Hz sits 2 % from the hover 2P (180 Hz) and 9 % from the cruise 2P (200 Hz). The forcing sweeps 90-156 Hz (1P) and 180-312 Hz (2P) between hover and the capped maximum, so no bare-tube mode in 72-374 Hz clears 20 % at every steady point: the fin bond must put the first mode above ~375 Hz, or the tap test must show it damped (R-VIBRATION allows either). C4 owns the fix.

nodes.title: Static margin trimmable, elevons neutral (S5010)
nodes.how: B2: XFOIL cm at the cruise Re (~3.5e5) with elevon deflection; B3: AVL trim at the cruise CL and SM 5 %. Flight: elevon trim position in FBWA (A2 limit elevon_trim_travel_max).
nodes.note: Informational since D-19 (SM stays 0.05; CR-J1-02 rejected). The S5010's cm0 is about zero (-0.004 at Re 2.3e5, +0.003 at 3e5, B2), so elevons-neutral it trims no positive static margin (-0.9 %): all 5 % of SM is carried by elevon up-trim (B2: about -4 deg at CL 0.5), and that penalty is already inside the trimmed CLmax 0.80 (CL-B2-CLMAX-DESIGN). The MH 45's +0.0145 would have trimmed 3.3 % at this CL. R-STATIC-MARGIN is verified by B3's CL-B3-CG-AFT, not by this screen.
reasons: uses P:b2.xfoil.cm0_2d_re2.3e5, which is UNVERIFIED (cites SRC-B2-XFOIL, which is UNVERIFIED)

nodes.how: Maker sheet (35 A at 12 AWG, 85 K rise); Holybro says 30 A for < 60 degC rise. Bench: 34 A for 10 min, connector < 60 degC.
nodes.note: PROPOSED from the datasheet; +4 % on the Amass figure against 33.75 A, and Holybro's 30 A (< 60 degC) already fails it. Against E2's 37.4 A (CL-J1-DISCONNECT-REQ-PESS) the XT60 fails on both figures. 12 AWG leads required.

nodes.title: XT60 continuous rating vs E2 gate-wind hover

nodes.note: FAILS by 6 %: the XT60 only passes R-DISCONNECT if F1 sizes on 27 A rather than E2's 29.9 A.
reasons: FAILS: margin -6.3% (35 A vs >= 37.36 A)

nodes.title: Tap test, fin + tube + motor assembly
nodes.procedure: Clamp the finished half-fin at the through-core block; tap the motor; FFT of a phone accelerometer or the FC IMU raw log; first mode must be >= 20 % from 1P and 2P at hover, cruise and the capped maximum (outside 72-374 Hz), or its damping ratio recorded for C4.

nodes.title: Three-point bend of the bought tube
nodes.procedure: Span 0.8 m, load at centre in 0.5 kg steps to 4 kg, dial gauge; E = F L^3 / (48 I delta). Replaces ASM-J1-E-TUBE.

nodes.title: Connector heat run
nodes.procedure: 37 A through the mated pair for 10 min on the bench supply or thrust stand; IR thermometer; rise <= 60 degC.
